verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Sketch acting only as an MCP server: AI clients such as ChatGPT or Claude connect to Sketch's built-in local server. Nothing shows Sketch acting as an MCP client that can plug in external MCP servers and use their tools. Server-side MCP support belongs to a different story and earns no credit here, and a design tool with AI features could plausibly consume MCP servers, so the axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
